traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for story 024.0-DEV-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE-REFS are satisfied. The `normalizeCommentLine` helper centrally strips backtick-wrapped content with length-preserving spaces, ensuring inline-code references to `@story`, `@req`, and `@supports` do not produce false positives, while real annotations on the same or other lines are still detected. Dedicated tests explicitly tied to this story validate the core behavior, common documentation patterns, mixed real+inline-code cases, multiple backtick segments, and non-backtick regression behavior. The full Jest test suite passes, providing regression assurance.
